mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses equity discount rates and increases risk appetite, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 105.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, increasing recession risks and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate output declines.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO < 105.0, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: CPI index exceeding 240 signals high inflation, prompting Federal Reserve rate hikes that increase equity discount rates and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 240, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production relative to its 12-month moving average signals manufacturing weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants react to near-term output slowdowns.
failure_condition: INDPRO shows sustained decline (relative to 12-month MA) but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Joint declines in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate profit outlooks.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), S&P 500 underperforms over the next 60 trading days due to prolonged consumer spending reductions and corporate hiring freezes impacting earnings growth.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.
